''See also: [[Ruler technique Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Ruler techniques]] are specialized methods used by [[sacred artists]] to manipulate [[vital aura]] in the surrounding environment. Unlike other techniques that focus on the user's own [[madra]], [[Ruler techniques]] utilize [[madra]] as a catalyst to command external forces such as wind, water, fire, light, or blood. These techniques allow users to exert control over the physical world, such as lifting massive objects, creating barriers of air, or influencing the minds and senses of others through illusions. While these techniques can be incredibly powerful, they require significant concentration and time to build, making them more difficult to deploy rapidly compared to [[Striker]] or [[Enforcer techniques]]. The effectiveness of a [[Ruler]] technique often depends on the availability and strength of compatible aura in the vicinity. Mastery of these techniques can involve complex patterns woven into the spirit, and advanced practitioners may even layer them with other types of techniques to create multifaceted attacks or defenses. Although some paths lack the ability to use [[Ruler techniques]] entirely, many artists strive to master them to increase the weight and influence of their combat style.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Ruler techniques]] are specialized abilities that allow a user to command nearby aura to obey their will. These powers have been utilized by various combatants, including attackers and the enemy forces during battle, as well as by [[Red Faith]]. The techniques serve diverse purposes, such as sealing the stones of a fortress wall together, stripping logs, or spreading a storm through [[Calan Archer]]'s [[cycling]] of the ability. While [[Lindon]] has struggled to gain control over such a technique, others like [[Yan Shoumei]] have used them to command their own combat styles. Furthermore, certain effects like unnatural terror can be produced by these abilities, though an [[Archlord]]'s technique may be pushed away with [[soulfire]] or resisted by individuals like [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]].}}
